{{Top|leg}}
A '''laser-link security fence''' was a type of security barrier. Used in [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] tracks, the security fence was designed to stop spectators from accessing the track. Authorized [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] could override the fence to gain access to the restricted area.
